text:
#!name=富途牛牛
#!desc=fmz200/wool_scripts · 某些APP要清除缓存或者重新安装拦截广告才会生效！
#!author=奶思

[MITM]
hostname = api*.futunn.com

[Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/api\.futunn\.com\/v2\/optimus\/my-homepage-config/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/api\.futunn\.com\/v2\/config\/promote-config/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/api\d\.futunn\.com\/ad\//i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/api\.futunn\.com\/v\d\/ad\//i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/api\.futunn\.com\/treasure-chest\/box-data/i then reject(404)
